description: ИПЦ: продовольственные товары, к соответствующему месяцу прошлого года
methodology: Index, same month of the previous year = 100: CPI for food products (Taldau index 703076, term 4772574), monthly from 2011-01, national. Same index and dictionaries as the headline CPI; December year-on-year values equal BNS element 1548 for 2011-2025. Before 2011: 1994-01 onward from BNS's printed history. History: 1994-01..2010-12 (204 months) from BNS's printed history (data/reference/bns_cpi_history.csv, scripts/load_cpi_history.py), equal to Taldau on all 11 months both carry (2011-12..2021-12).
